source.snippet: I want a Linux CLI tool that helps new contributors onboard to a repo. Desired workflow: Repo ships a JSON Schema (or YAML form of it). After git clone, a developer runs a single command that interactively prompts for values, validates them against the schema (including checking that any referenced files/dirs exist), and writes a per-project TOML config file... The same command should also make those configuration values available as environment variables...

problem_statement: Engineering teams have no standard CLI tool to interactively onboard new contributors by prompting them to fill in a project config from a schema, validate inputs, and produce local environment files — forcing custom scripts or manual documentation per repo.
target_segment: Platform/DevEx engineers and open-source maintainers at software companies who manage multi-contributor repos and spend time on onboarding friction.
notes: Highly specific, well-articulated unmet need posted on Software Recs SE with zero answers — indicating genuine gap not met by existing tools. Business context: DevEx tooling is a recurring spend category at engineering orgs. A productized CLI or VS Code extension with schema-driven onboarding could sell to platform teams. Related to mise/direnv ecosystem. Moderate signal strength — single post but very concrete spec suggests real pain.
